# agent-sandbox

> Policy guard for agent shell commands: allow-listed absolute executables, path roots, process-tree timeout, capped output and scrubbed environment. Python package `trysac-agent-sandbox`, import name `agent_sandbox`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies. It is a policy guard, not a security boundary.
